headline: The A8^3 Niemeier extension couples the three SU(9)_1 factors by a 27-sector simple-current glue code C <= (Z9)^3, C ~= Z9 x Z3, generated by permutations of (1,1,4). The first cross-factor fields occur at weight 2; weight-one remains sl9^3. The glue constrains SU(9) center charges, while the F3^4 Pauli degrees in each adjoint factor remain independent.
fusion_rule: V_c x V_d -> V_{c+d mod 9}; the 27 glue sectors form the simple-current group C.

pauli_intertwining.center_charge_action: the SU(9) center zeta_9 I acts on Lambda^k(9) by zeta_9^k
pauli_intertwining.glue_selection: only triples of center charges (k1,k2,k3) in C occur in the extended lattice VOA
pauli_intertwining.Pauli_action_on_sector: P(v1) tensor P(v2) tensor P(v3), with P(vi) induced on Lambda^ki(9)
pauli_intertwining.reason: adjoint Pauli currents have center charge 0, so glue extension does not identify or equate the three F3^4 labels; it couples the factors through their Z9 center/simple-current charges instead.
